create.name: Mel Collins
create.bio:
Mel Collins is a British author, psychotherapeutic counsellor and spiritual teacher who has worked mainly with highly sensitive people and empaths for some twenty years. Before that she spent a decade in the prison service, first as a counsellor and then for eight years as a prison governor, and finding her own sensitivity tested in that setting led her to study the trait closely. Alongside an integrative counselling diploma, she trained in Reiki to master level, in Deep Memory Process regression with the Jungian therapist Roger Woolger, and as an accredited spiritual healer.

Her Handbook for Highly Sensitive People, published by Watkins in 2019 with a foreword by the broadcaster Jeremy Vine, has since been translated into about a dozen languages, and she followed it with a pocket book of affirmations for sensitive people. Based in Devon, she sees a small number of clients each month, in person or online, for sessions that weave together coaching, transpersonal work and energy healing, and she advises as an HSP consultant. Her workshops cover high sensitivity, affirmations, EFT tapping, energy protection, angels and the sacred feminine, and she speaks to businesses and at events such as the College of Psychic Studies in London. On Insight Timer she shares angelic and Mary Magdalene meditations.

books.title: The Handbook for Highly Sensitive People: How to Transform Feeling Overwhelmed and Frazzled to Empowered and Fulfilled
books.author: Mel Collins
books.description: A practical guide to the trait of high sensitivity, with a self-assessment, a look at the gifts of empathy and intuition, and tools for boundaries, self-worth, energy protection and tapping. Published by Watkins in 2019 with a foreword by Jeremy Vine.

courses.title: Healing & Coaching Sessions
courses.description: A limited number of one-to-one sessions each month that combine her coaching, transpersonal and energy work, mainly for highly sensitive people, empaths and women reconnecting with their intuition. In person or online; book by email.

courses.title: Workshops for Sensitive People
courses.description: A menu of workshops she runs in person or online, on understanding high sensitivity, affirmations, EFT tapping, energy protection, self-worth, angels, the sacred feminine and manifesting. Groups and centres can book private sessions.

courses.title: HSP Talks and Training for Businesses
courses.description: Talks and training for employers on what high sensitivity is, how it shows up at work and how organisations can help sensitive staff do their best work without burning out.

free_resources.title: Mel Collins on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations with an angelic and sacred-feminine flavour, including a daily angel protection practice for sensitive people and a longer journey with Mary Magdalene. Free to listen.

The bio mentions only that she was a prison governor.
